notes: SNIPE Hunt magnetometer network searching for hidden-photon (kinetic mixing epsilon) and axion (g_agamma) dark matter via Earth-as-transducer magnetic signatures in 0.5-5 Hz range. Primary/headline result is HPDM kinetic mixing (best experimental bound in this frequency range), so DarkPhoton chosen. The paper ALSO sets AxionPhoton limits g_agamma ~ 6e-9 to 3e-8 GeV^-1 over the same mass range (m_a ~ 2e-15 to 2e-14 eV, Fig 12). Mass converted from Compton frequency via m=4.136e-15*f. Epsilon values (~few×10^-6 to 10^-5) read approximately from Fig 6 averaged traces; not from a numerical table. Two independent scans (Scan-1, Scan-2) presented; values approximate the combined/averaged limit.
